task.title: Prepare HealthKit Activity and Nutrition graduation path

result.summary: Complete dormant graduation path for HealthKit Activity/Nutrition deployed with both policy scopes (projection, evidenceEligibility) absent in production. Server 93491bc5 adds a pure read-time overlay projecting accepted canonical days into the ordinary activity_day/nutrition shape for six existing read seams, gated by a two-scope Server-owned policy; the ONLY writer is a new runner whose dry run is the graduation simulation itself. Review of the first candidate found a real BLOCKER (Activity merge could silently override an existing explicit Founder correction) and fixed it, plus three minor/note items; final Server verdict APPROVE. Native candidate c116867f (reviewed, not built/uploaded, extends the pending Build 50 lineage) needed only a zero-meal Nutrition copy fix and a meal-average denominator fix; review found one real MAJOR (the copy check gated on calories alone) and fixed it; final Native verdict APPROVE WITH NON-BLOCKING FOLLOW-UPS. Source-invariance proven for Activity, Nutrition and Energy (identical factual V3 observations regardless of transport, no duplicate observation, no double-counted workout calories). Zero-write proof: HealthKit-specific collections byte-identical, no graduation policy record exists, Sep 21 test day unchanged, Training/Confidence/briefing collections unchanged. A deploy gotcha recurred (PHYSIQUEOS_GIT_SHA/BUILD_ID are separate spec env fields, not auto-derived) and was caught and corrected before publishing this report.

tests.summary: Server unit 8517 (+80 over base) with 298 failures identical to the base and zero new; all ten phase suites identical failure sets to the base; ESLint clean; exact-SHA production build succeeded. Native full suite 1258 tests, 0 failures.

review.summary: Independent fresh-context Server review found and the author fixed one real BLOCKER (silent override of an existing Founder Activity correction) plus 3 minor/note items, mutation-tested by both author and reviewer against the reviewer's exact repro; final verdict APPROVE on 93491bc5. Independent fresh-context Native review found and the author fixed one real MAJOR (zero-meal copy gated on calories alone) plus 2 minor items; final verdict APPROVE WITH NON-BLOCKING FOLLOW-UPS on c116867f, with a recommendation to merge into the Build 50 lineage.

zero_write_audit.summary: HealthKit-specific collections (canonical days, configuration, observations) byte-identical before and after the deploy with unchanged last-write timestamps; no graduation policy record exists; Training/goal/confidence/briefing collection digests unchanged; the Sep 21 canonicalization policy and canonical days are the same records observed at task start. Unrelated, ordinary Founder Evidence-intake activity was observed during the deploy window and is documented as organic, not caused by this task's code (which touches no Evidence write path).

decisions_required: Choose when to run the completed-day Activity + Nutrition Sep 21 audit (a new task id; Founder sets the canary date back to 2026-09-21 before the after-midnight sync).

Authorize Build 50 (now carrying both the dormant Workout canary and this graduation UI, per the Native reviewer's recommendation) after Activity + Nutrition acceptance -- no change from the existing decision to keep waiting.
After the completed-day audit is GREEN, authorize the graduation dry run and then the policy transition itself (projection, then evidence eligibility, as two separate authorized applies).
unexpected_findings: A real defect found by review: the Activity graduation merge checked only the incoming HealthKit side for an explicit-correction marker, never the existing side, so a Founder-typed correction could have been silently overridden by a lower-authority HealthKit read once graduation is ever turned on. Fixed before deploy.

A real defect found by review: the Native zero-meal copy gate checked only the calories field; a day with populated macros but a missing calories value would still have shown the stale 'no meals' string. Fixed.

The App Platform PHYSIQUEOS_GIT_SHA and PHYSIQUEOS_BUILD_ID values are separately-maintained spec environment fields, not derived from the deployed commit. The first force-rebuild deployment showed the correct source_commit_hash in the deployment record but the runtime still reported the prior SHA; caught by a direct runtime probe (not by the deployment API alone), corrected in the spec, and redeployed before any zero-write audit or completion claim was made.

Ordinary Founder Evidence-intake activity occurred in production during the deploy window, unrelated to this task; its timestamps were cross-checked against the deploy's own build/deploy phases to confirm no causal link.
